citation: McCartan, Lucy, and Gettings, M.E., 1991, Possible relationship between seismicity and warm intrusive bodies in the Charleston, South Carolina, and New Madrid, Missouri, areas: U.S. Geological Survey Bulletin 1953, map scale 1:690,000.
notes: Bulletin on seismicity and inferred warm mafic intrusions at Charleston, S.C. and New Madrid, Mo.; only South Carolina content recorded (New Madrid plutons, Blytheville arch and heat-flow data skipped). Heat-flow values (Charleston area published mean about 50-54 mW/m2; background 43 mW/m2; mean over inferred plutons about 53 mW/m2; Clubhouse Crossroads corehole value printed as '558 mW/m 2', probably 55 plus a map symbol) have no schema field and are not stored. Figure 4 units are generalized cross-section units. Out-of-state and general references skipped. Page 25-26 not in packet (blank or covers).
